newsitem.title: USA: CBOT OVERNIGHT PROJECT A AG VOLUME 1,862 CONTRACTS.
newsitem.headline: CBOT OVERNIGHT PROJECT A AG VOLUME 1,862 CONTRACTS.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said its Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totaled 1,862 contracts compared with 706 overnight Thursday.
There were 85 wheat, 793 corn, 869 soybean, 28 soymeal, 57 soyoil, four oat, eight wheat calls, eight corn calls, nine soybean calls and one soybean put traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was 1-1/4 to 2-3/4 cents lower, corn was 4-1/2 to 5-3/4 cents lower and soybeans were 11-3/4 to 13-1/2 cents lower.
